sections.heading: When does the Mumbai school calendar make a paid hour worth most?
paragraphs: The months that repay paid hours are September to November in the first Diploma year and January to March in the second. That is when Internal Assessment drafts cluster, when mocks land, and when the Extended Essay has to move from a vague interest to a researchable question. Hours bought in June, before the student holds any assessed work at all, mostly buy revision of last year.

Most Mumbai IB and IGCSE schools run an April to March or June to April year with the May examination session as the default, and their internal deadlines sit weeks ahead of the official ones so that teachers have marking time. Families at Dhirubhai Ambani International School in Bandra Kurla Complex, Cathedral and John Connon School in Fort, Ecole Mondiale World School in Juhu and Hiranandani Foundation School in Powai will all recognise the same squeeze: a Physics IA draft, a TOK essay outline and a Mathematics test in the same fortnight, usually just before a Diwali or Christmas break that was supposed to be a rest.

The November session changes the shape of the year. Students at schools entering candidates in November, and IGCSE candidates sitting the October to November series, hit their mock period mid-year instead. That is useful for a family working to a budget, because the quiet months are different from everyone else's and experienced tutors have real availability then. Oberoi International School in Goregaon East, NES International School in Mulund West, Smt. Sulochanadevi Singhania School in Thane and D.Y. Patil International School in Nerul in Navi Mumbai between them cover most of the calendar variations you will meet in this city.

Use this deliberately. If the school's own mock timetable falls in February, book your concentrated block for January and the first half of February and leave March alone; by March the student needs sleep and past papers more than a new voice. If the Extended Essay supervisor meeting is in August, spend one paid hour in July getting the question right and then let the supervisor do the job the school already employs her to do. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any of the schools named here. We name them only because their calendars are the clock your family is actually running on.

January to February in DP2: mocks, paper technique and IA final drafts.

sections.heading: Home tuition, online or a short hybrid block in Mumbai?
paragraphs: Home tuition is the default for a reason: a tutor sitting at your dining table sees the notebook, the unmarked past paper and the phone, and a Mumbai student in Years 1 to 12 who will not switch on a camera will still sit down at a table. Online makes sense when the job is narrow and specific. Hybrid is usually the most efficient use of a small number of hours.

Families who want an affordable IB tutor in Mumbai often assume home tuition is the expensive option because travel sits inside it. Sometimes it is. But home tuition also removes the thing that wastes the most paid time: the first ten minutes of an online session spent finding the file, scanning the question and discovering the student has not attempted the work. A home tuition slot with the folder already open and a parent within earshot tends to use the whole session. When you are funding few sessions, waste matters more than rate.

Online is right when the subject is scarce and the tutor is not local. If you need someone who has marked Higher Level Economics IAs, or who teaches Mathematics Applications and Interpretation at Higher Level, the right person may be in Pune or Chennai, and an IB online tutor in Mumbai is quite often a tutor who is not in Mumbai at all. Online also lets you buy one short conversation about an IA question, which nobody will travel to Kharghar to deliver. Screen-shared past papers work well; a shared whiteboard for long mathematics working is slower than paper.

Hybrid is what most budget-conscious families should actually ask for. One home session to set the plan and see the work, then short online check-ins to hold the student to it, then one more home session before the deadline. The travel appears twice instead of weekly, and a check-in can be shorter than a full session. An IB private tutor in Mumbai working this way will usually also agree to a shared slot: two students from the same society or the same class, same subject, same level, one session. Pairing works when both students are genuinely at the same point and fails badly when one is a grade ahead, because the tutor drifts towards the weaker one while both families pay. Ask the tutor to tell you honestly whether the pair fits.
bullets: Home tuition: best when the student will not start work unsupervised.
Online: best for scarce subjects and single short conversations about an IA.
Hybrid: one home session, short online check-ins, one home session before the deadline.
Shared slot: only when both students are genuinely at the same point.
Ask for travel time, not only availability, before agreeing a standing slot.

sections.heading: What to check yourself before you fund a single session
paragraphs: IB Gram checks identity, qualifications, teaching history and whether a tutor has genuinely taught the component you need. You should check one more thing yourself, and it is the one that decides whether a low rate is a saving at all: ask the tutor which assessment model they teach to, and listen for whether they describe the current one.

A tutor who does not know the current assessment model is not a saving at any rate. The Diploma Programme has changed in ways that matter. Theory of Knowledge is assessed through an exhibition and an essay rather than the old presentation. Mathematics is now Analysis and Approaches or Applications and Interpretation rather than Studies, Standard Level and Higher Level. Several sciences have revised internal assessment criteria, and subject guides are revised on a rolling cycle. A tutor still drilling a retired format will produce confident work that is marked against criteria it was never written for. The student loses the marks and you lose the hours, which is a worse outcome than not having hired anyone.

Four questions separate a current tutor from a merely cheap one. First: which syllabus version are you teaching, and when does it next change? Second: can you mark this answer of my daughter's against the published criteria and tell me the band and why? Third: what do examiner reports say students lose marks on in this paper? Fourth: what will the first session produce that I can actually see? A tutor who has taught the subject recently answers all four without hesitating. One who has not will talk about experience and confidence instead. Hunting for an affordable IB tutor in Mumbai should never mean skipping those questions, because asking them costs nothing.

Check your own side too. Ask for identity verification and then look at it. Ask whether the tutor has taught your child's board rather than only the subject, because IGCSE Extended Mathematics and Diploma Programme Mathematics are different animals. If you found someone by searching IB tutors near me in Mumbai and the only evidence is a listing, ask for one reference from a family whose child sat the same paper. And set the review point before the first session rather than after the fourth: say out loud that you will both reassess after session two.
bullets: Ask which syllabus version the tutor teaches and when it last changed.
Ask the tutor to mark one answer against the published criteria, aloud.
Confirm they have taught your child's board, not only the subject.
Agree the review point before the first session, not after the fourth.
Treat an unverifiable listing as a reason to ask for a reference.

sections.heading: What parents mean by an affordable IB tutor in Mumbai
paragraphs: When a parent types affordable IB tutor in Mumbai into Google, the real question is almost never which tutor charges least. It is: how do I get more out of fewer hours than the family next door is buying? The answer has three parts. Spend the hours at the right moment, use the help you have already paid for, and buy the one skill that reduces future sessions.

Start with the second part, because most families never use it. Your school fee already includes a subject teacher with a consultation slot, and most departments run a clinic or subject surgery that is attended by almost nobody. The Extended Essay supervisor is contracted to give your child supervision meetings and a reflection conversation, and a student who arrives with a written draft question gets far more from them than one who arrives with nothing. The school librarian can usually obtain journal access that would otherwise sit behind a paywall. Past papers, mark schemes, examiner reports, the published subject guides and the assessment criteria for every subject are available through the school's coordinator. A student who has read the criteria for her own IA has done something most students never do, and it costs nothing.

Now the first part. A weekly session all year is the default because it is easy to arrange, and it is often the least efficient thing a budget-constrained family can buy. Spread thin, it becomes homework supervision: the tutor arrives, asks what was set, and the hour goes on this week's worksheet. The same hours concentrated into the fortnight when the IA question is being chosen, or the three weeks before mocks, do something a weekly drip cannot. They change a decision or build a technique while there is still time to use it. Most families asking about IB home tuition in Mumbai should be asking about when, not how often.

The third part is the only investment that genuinely reduces future sessions. Ask the tutor explicitly to teach your child to self-mark. That means sitting with the published band descriptors or criteria, marking her own work before she hears the tutor's verdict, and defending the band she gave herself. A student who can predict her own mark within a band has stopped needing somebody to tell her whether the work is good, and that is the point at which tuition becomes optional rather than ongoing. It is uncomfortable for the first few sessions, which is why most tutors do not offer it unless you ask.

On money, the honest version: IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on the board, the level, how scarce the subject is, how far the tutor travels and how long the session runs, which is why nobody can quote you anything sensible without those facts. IB Gram does not claim to be the cheapest option in this city, and we will not tell you we are better value than someone you have not met. What we will do is tell you when the hours you are considering are unlikely to be worth buying, and what to use instead.
bullets: Use the subject teacher's consultation slot before you buy any tuition.
Attend the department clinic; most of them run half empty.
Bring a written draft question to the Extended Essay supervisor meeting.
Get past papers, mark schemes and subject guides from the coordinator.
Ask the tutor to teach self-marking against the published criteria.
Concentrate hours around a decision or a deadline, not across a year.

sections.heading: What four weeks, one term and one exam cycle should show in Mumbai
paragraphs: At four weeks you should see a change in what the student can do unprompted, not a change in grade. At one term you should see marks moving on the kind of assessment you funded help for. At one exam cycle you should see a predicted grade the school is willing to defend. IB Gram does not guarantee grades, and nobody honest will.

Be specific about four weeks, because this is where families working to a budget either stop wasting money or keep going out of politeness. After roughly four sessions a student should be able to tell you what the criteria for her next assessed piece are, in her own words. She should be attempting past paper questions without being told to open the book. She should be able to say which band her last answer sat in and why. If none of that has happened, the hours are buying company rather than teaching, and the right move is a direct conversation with the tutor, not another month.

At a term, look at the assessment you targeted. If you funded help with a Chemistry IA, the draft should have come back with better criterion marks and the student should be able to explain the evaluation she wrote. If you funded Mathematics because it was undermining Physics, the Physics calculation marks should have moved too, and that is the real test of whether you picked the right subject to fund. If a tutor is not working out, say so and ask IB Gram for a replacement. We do not require a reason beyond fit, there is no notice period to work through, and the replacement is matched with the same shortlist discipline as the first.

The limits are worth saying plainly. A narrow number of hours cannot repair two years of missed foundations in the term before examinations, and a tutor who tells you otherwise is selling. A student who does nothing between sessions will not improve however good the tutor is, and that is the most common reason tuition fails here, not tutor quality. Spending less on tuition says nothing whatever about how much a family cares; some of the most carefully run Diploma Programme years we see are managed on very few paid hours and a great deal of attention to timing.
bullets: Four weeks: the student can state the criteria for her next assessed piece.
Four weeks: past paper attempts happen without being asked.
One term: marks move on the assessment you actually funded.
One exam cycle: a predicted grade the school is willing to defend.
Any point: ask for a replacement tutor, with no reason needed beyond fit.

sections.heading: Telling a tutor your constraint plainly before the first home tuition session in Mumbai
paragraphs: Say it in one sentence. We can fund a limited number of sessions, we want them spent on the Physics IA before the February draft deadline, and we need to know after the second session whether this is working. A reasonable tutor hears that as useful information rather than as a haggle, and plans backwards from your deadline instead of proposing a term.

Here is what a reasonable tutor does with that information. She asks for the assignment brief and the criteria before the first session so that no paid time goes on reading them. She proposes a sequence with an end rather than a standing slot. She tells you which parts of the job the school can do for nothing and declines to be paid for those. She suggests a longer first session and shorter follow-ups, because diagnosis needs time and checking does not. And she tells you if the honest answer is that the student needs two sessions and a week of past papers rather than eight weeks of her company.

Prepare four things before the first home tuition session anywhere in Mumbai: the last report or progress sheet, the brief and criteria for whatever is due next, one piece of marked work with the teacher's comments still on it, and a quiet table with a plug point. Tell the tutor which gate your society uses and who to ask for, and give your building desk the tutor's name before the slot so the first ten minutes are not spent at the barrier. If the student has a school clinic she is not attending, mention that too, because a good tutor will send her there.

The first session itself should produce something you can look at. Usually that is a short written diagnosis: what the student can do, what she cannot, which of her next three deadlines is at risk, and what the plan for the funded sessions is. If you reach the end of the first session with nothing written down, ask for it. A family funding few hours is entitled to know exactly what each one bought, and a tutor who cannot say is not the right tutor whatever the rate.
bullets: State how many sessions you can fund and which deadline they serve.
Ask for a sequence with an end rather than a standing weekly slot.
Send the assignment brief and criteria before the first session, not during.
Clear the tutor's name with your society gate desk the day before.
Expect a written diagnosis at the end of the first session.

faqs.question: We can only fund one subject. Which one should it be?
faqs.answer: Fund the subject where a small amount of help unblocks the most, which is usually not the subject with the lowest mark. Look for the weakness that is showing up inside other subjects: a Mathematics gap costing marks in Physics calculations, Chemistry moles and Economics diagrams is one purchase that improves three grades. A low History mark caused by unpractised essay structure will often respond to the department's own feedback and a pile of past papers. Ask each subject teacher one question: is this understanding or is this practice? Fund the understanding problems and let the school handle the practice ones.

faqs.question: Is a weekly session all year better than a short block at the right moment?
faqs.answer: Usually the block is better. A weekly session spread across a year tends to drift into homework supervision, where the hour goes on whatever worksheet was set that week and nothing structural changes. The same hours concentrated into the fortnight when an Internal Assessment question is chosen, or the three weeks before mocks, land while the student can still act on them. The exception is a student who genuinely will not work without a standing appointment. For her, the weekly slot buys discipline rather than teaching, which is a legitimate thing to buy as long as you know that is what you are paying for.

faqs.question: What help are we already paying for that we are probably not using?
faqs.answer: More than most families realise. Your school fee includes the subject teacher's consultation slot, a departmental clinic that usually runs half empty, the Extended Essay supervisor's contracted supervision meetings, and a librarian who can often obtain journal access that is otherwise behind a paywall. The school's Diploma Programme coordinator can supply past papers, mark schemes, examiner reports, the published subject guides and the assessment criteria for every subject your child takes. None of that costs anything extra. A student who reads the criteria for her own assessment before writing it has done the highest-value thing available, and no tutor is needed for it.

faqs.question: Can a tutor teach my child to mark her own work so that we need fewer sessions later?
faqs.answer: Yes, and you should ask for it explicitly, because most tutors will not offer. Self-marking means the student grades her own answer against the published band descriptors before the tutor says anything, then defends the band she chose. It is uncomfortable for the first few sessions and then it changes everything: a student who can predict her own mark within a band no longer needs somebody to tell her whether the work is good. That is the one skill that genuinely reduces future tuition, so if you are funding a narrow number of sessions, make it the stated goal of the last two.

faqs.question: Is the cheapest tutor we can find a saving?
faqs.answer: Not if the tutor does not know the current assessment model. The Diploma Programme has moved: Theory of Knowledge is assessed through an exhibition and an essay rather than the old presentation, Mathematics is now Analysis and Approaches or Applications and Interpretation, and subject guides are revised on a rolling cycle. A tutor still teaching a retired format produces confident work that is marked against criteria it was never written for, and the student loses marks she would otherwise have had. Ask any tutor which syllabus version they teach and when it last changed. If the answer is vague, the rate is beside the point.

faqs.question: Can two families share a tutor and split one session?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it works well when both students are genuinely at the same point. Same subject, same board, same level, same assessment coming up, and ideally the same class, so that the tutor is not teaching two syllabi in one hour. It fails when one student is a grade ahead: the tutor drifts to the weaker one, the stronger one is bored, and both families pay for an hour that served one child. Two students in the same Powai or Kharghar society with the same Physics IA deadline is close to the ideal case. Ask the tutor to say honestly whether the pair fits before you commit.

faqs.question: Our society in Powai asks for a gate pass for every visitor. How does a weekly home tuition slot work?
faqs.answer: Register the tutor once as a recurring visitor rather than clearing her at the gate every week. Most Mumbai societies, including the larger Powai and Hiranandani Gardens complexes, will add a tutor to a standing-visitor or service-provider list once a resident submits the name, a photo identity reference and the slot timing to the managing committee or the facility app. Do this before the first session, not during it, or the opening ten minutes of a paid hour go at the barrier. Tell the tutor which gate to use and who to ask for; in large layouts the wrong gate means a long walk between towers.

faqs.question: Does a parent need to be at home during a home tuition session?
faqs.answer: Someone responsible should be in the flat, but they should not be in the room. Younger MYP and IGCSE students work better with a parent within earshot and out of sight. A parent sitting in corrects, prompts and answers for the child, which hides exactly the weakness you are paying to find. For a Diploma Programme student, a closed door and a check-in at the end is better. What a parent should do is read the written diagnosis after the first session and ask the tutor one question at the end of each visit: what could she not do today?

faqs.question: We live off Ghodbunder Road in Thane and the evening traffic is unpredictable. Which slot actually holds?
faqs.answer: Match a tutor who already lives on your side of Ghodbunder Road, and take an earlier slot than feels natural. A tutor coming from near Thane station reaches Kasarvadavali in about twenty minutes off-peak and close to an hour in the evening peak, so an evening slot that depends on that run will slip most weeks and then quietly stop. A tutor based in Majiwada, Pokhran Road or Hiranandani Estate holds the same slot all term. If no local tutor teaches the subject, take a Saturday morning home session with online check-ins midweek rather than fighting the Ghodbunder stretch.

faqs.question: What happens if the tutor is not working out after two sessions?
faqs.answer: Tell us and we match a replacement from the same shortlist; you do not need a reason beyond fit. There is no notice period and no obligation to complete a block. Say what specifically is not working, because it changes who we send. A tutor who explains well but cannot hold a distracted student is a different problem from one who is current on the syllabus but arrives unprepared. If the real issue is that your child has not done the work between sessions, a new tutor will not fix it, and we will say so rather than send you another one.

faqs.question: Is online tuition enough if we are only funding a few sessions?
faqs.answer: For a narrow, well-defined job, yes. One conversation to settle an Internal Assessment question, a walkthrough of a single marked past paper, or a check-in on Extended Essay progress all work online and cost no travel time. For diagnosis, home tuition is better, because the tutor sees the notebook, the unmarked worksheets and how the student actually sits down to work. The pattern that suits a tight budget is hybrid: one home session in Mumbai to diagnose and plan, short online check-ins to hold the plan in place, and one home session shortly before the deadline.

faqs.question: When in the Mumbai school year should we spend the hours we have?
faqs.answer: September to November in the first Diploma year and January to February in the second, for May session candidates. That is when Internal Assessment questions are chosen, the Extended Essay question has to be settled and mocks arrive, which are the moments paid help changes an outcome. Avoid the fortnight immediately before real examinations: the student needs past papers and sleep rather than a new voice. November session families, and IGCSE candidates sitting the October to November series, should shift the whole pattern by roughly half a year, and will often find good tutors far more available.

sections.heading: How we shortlist an IB and IGCSE home tutor in Airoli
paragraphs: A request for an IB and IGCSE home tutor in Airoli usually arrives as three lines: the sector, the school, and the two subjects that have started slipping. That is enough to begin with. It is not enough to produce a match that survives a full term, so the first conversation is about geography and timing as much as it is about academics. Which sector are you in, which side of the Thane-Belapur Road, and what time does your child actually walk through the door on a weekday?

Those questions come first because Airoli is not a typical Navi Mumbai node. It is the northernmost node, one stop from Thane station on the Trans-Harbour Line, and tied to the Eastern Suburbs by the Airoli-Mulund bridge. A tutor living in Thane West reaches a flat in Airoli Sector 8 more reliably on a Tuesday evening than a tutor coming up from Nerul or Belapur does. So the search order is deliberately inverted here: Thane first, then Airoli itself, then Ghansoli and Kopar Khairane.

Once the geography is settled, the shortlist is built on board experience rather than general subject confidence. A graduate who teaches state-board Class 10 Mathematics well is not automatically ready for Cambridge IGCSE Mathematics 0580 Extended or for a Diploma Programme (DP) Mathematics internal assessment. We ask which syllabus codes a tutor has taught, how recently they taught them, and whether they have ever marked or moderated coursework. Two or three names then reach you, each with the board experience written out, the travel time from their home to yours, and the weekly slots they can genuinely hold.

You meet one of them for a diagnostic session in your own flat. That first sitting is not a lesson. It is forty to sixty minutes of finding out what the child can do unaided, which is almost never what the term report says. The tutor writes back a short plan afterwards: what to fix first, what to leave until the next unit, and what the parent can stop worrying about. sections.heading: Which programme is your child actually in: PYP, MYP, DP or IGCSE?
paragraphs: Four structures matter to a family here. The International Baccalaureate (IB) runs the Primary Years Programme (PYP) up to Grade 5, the Middle Years Programme (MYP) from Grade 6 to Grade 10, and the Diploma Programme (DP) in Grades 11 and 12. Cambridge International Education runs IGCSE in Grades 9 and 10, and Pearson Edexcel runs the other main IGCSE route. Several Mumbai schools run two of these side by side, which is where the confusion starts.

PYP and MYP tutoring looks nothing like IGCSE tutoring. There is no single textbook to work through. A PYP child is assessed inside a unit of inquiry, so a home tutor who arrives with a worksheet pack has already misread the job; the work is reading stamina, number sense and the habit of explaining a method out loud. MYP is criterion-based, with four criteria per subject and descriptors that reward process as much as the right answer. A Grade 8 student who can solve the problem but cannot show a pattern, a justification and a reflection will sit in the middle band forever.

IGCSE is where the structure hardens. Each subject has a syllabus code, a fixed set of papers, and in several subjects a tiering decision between Core and Extended. The board matters too: a Cambridge paper and an Edexcel paper on the same topic are marked differently and timed differently, and a tutor who has only seen one of the two will coach the wrong exam technique. The DP adds a different kind of load again: six subjects, three at Higher Level (HL) and three at Standard Level (SL), plus Theory of Knowledge (TOK), the Extended Essay (EE) and Creativity, Activity, Service.

The crossover years are the ones that catch Airoli parents out. A child finishing MYP at one school and moving into IGCSE Grade 9 at another, or finishing IGCSE and entering DP1, changes assessment system in a single July. Families attending Smt. Sulochanadevi Singhania School in Thane and D.Y. Patil International School in Nerul run into this from opposite directions, and the tutoring brief for that year is transition work rather than remedial work.

sections.heading: Subject choice, HL and SL, and Core versus Extended across both boards
paragraphs: All IB and IGCSE subjects are covered by at least one tutor in Airoli or the Thane pool next door, but subject coverage is the easy part. The decisions that change a result are tiering and level: whether a Grade 9 student sits IGCSE Core or Extended, and whether a DP1 student takes a subject at HL or SL. Those two choices are made months before the exam, often by default, and they are very hard to reverse once school entries close.

Here is the worked example we see most often in this part of Navi Mumbai. A Grade 9 student takes Cambridge IGCSE Mathematics 0580. Her school has pencilled her in for the Core tier after a weak Grade 8 year. Core means Paper 1 and Paper 3, and the grade ceiling on that tier is a C. Extended means Paper 2 and Paper 4, where the full range up to A* is available. She also says she wants DP Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches in Grade 11, and schools generally expect an Extended background for that course. So the tiering decision made quietly in Grade 9 is actually a DP subject decision made two years early.

What the tutor does with that is specific. In the diagnostic she is given a short non-calculator set in the style of Paper 2: indices, surds, rearranging algebraic fractions, and one bound-and-estimation question. Then one structured Paper 4 item on similar shapes and volume scale factor, where Core students typically stop at the length ratio. The point is not to score her. It is to see whether the gap is missing content, which is fixable in a term of home tuition, or missing confidence under timed conditions, which is fixable faster. The tier recommendation then goes back to the school with evidence attached, before entries close.

The same logic runs through the IB side. Every DP subject carries an internal assessment: an exploration in Mathematics, a scientific investigation in the sciences, an individual oral in Language and Literature, a historical investigation in History. These are marked by the teacher and moderated by the IB, they are drafted during the school year rather than in the exam hall, and they are where a well-organised student quietly banks marks. A home tutor working across all IB and IGCSE subjects in Airoli spends as much time on internal assessment scheduling as on content.

sections.heading: The school calendar Airoli families in Navi Mumbai plan around
paragraphs: Airoli children travel in two directions for an international curriculum, and the direction decides the calendar you live by. South along the Thane-Belapur Road and Palm Beach Road is D.Y. Patil International School in Nerul, which runs both IB and IGCSE pathways. North across the Trans-Harbour Line is Smt. Sulochanadevi Singhania School in Thane, which runs IGCSE. Between them they account for a large share of the school buses that leave the Airoli sectors before seven in the morning.

That early bus is the single biggest constraint on home tuition here, and it is worth saying plainly. A child who leaves at 6:45am and returns at 4:30pm after a bus ride down Palm Beach Road or back over the Thane side has roughly one usable study window before fatigue wins. Scheduling a demanding DP Physics session at 8:30pm because it suited the tutor is how families end up reporting that the tutoring is not working, when the real problem is the clock.

The year itself has four pressure points. June and July are quiet and are the cheapest weeks of the year to fix a foundation gap. October brings mid-term assessments and then the Diwali break, which is the last long stretch of usable time before things get serious. November and December are mock season for both boards, and in the DP this is also when internal assessment first drafts start landing. January to March is the crush: Cambridge and Edexcel IGCSE written papers run in the February to April window depending on board and series, DP internal assessments reach final submission, and the Extended Essay is signed off.

A tutor who knows these schools knows that the useful conversation in October is not about the mid-term. It is about what gets dropped in January so that the internal assessments, which are already worth a fixed share of the final grade, do not get written in a single panicked weekend. sections.heading: Home tuition, online or hybrid for an Airoli family?
paragraphs: Home tuition is the default here and it should be. IB and IGCSE home tuition in Airoli means a tutor at your table with the child's actual exercise book, the school worksheet pack and the teacher's feedback in front of them, which is information no online session ever sees in full. For MYP and IGCSE students in particular, where handwriting out a full method under timed conditions is half the skill, a tutor sitting beside the page catches habits that a screen share does not: skipped working, units dropped at the last line, a diagram drawn too small to label.

Online is the right call in two specific cases rather than as a general substitute. The first is scarcity: if your child needs DP Economics HL, Global Politics, Business Management or a second language at HL, the pool in the Navi Mumbai nodes thins out fast and an IB and IGCSE online tutor in Airoli from elsewhere in Mumbai beats a nearby generalist who has never taught the course. The second is the exam run-in, when an extra thirty-minute question-review slot at 9pm is worth far more than a cancelled ninety-minute session that nobody could travel to.

Hybrid is what most families here settle into by the second term without planning it. The main weekly session stays at home, usually on a weekend morning or an early weekday evening, and a shorter midweek check-in happens online. The practical gain is that a session is no longer hostage to the Airoli-Mulund bridge or to a bad evening on the Thane-Belapur Road. The practical cost is that the online half needs a working document camera or at least a phone stand, because a photographed page sent after the session is not the same as watching the method unfold.

The honest trade-off is attention, not technology. A twelve-year-old working online in a room with a television on will drift, and no platform fixes that. A sixteen-year-old drafting a Mathematics exploration can work online perfectly well, because the task is already a document on a screen. Match the mode to the age and the task rather than to the convenience of the adults, and say so to the tutor in week one so the plan is built around it.

sections.heading: How is a home tutor in Airoli checked before you meet them?
paragraphs: Every IB and IGCSE home tutor in Airoli on the platform clears the same three checks before a parent sees the profile. Identity is confirmed against a government photo document. Qualifications are confirmed against the degree certificate rather than a line on a CV. Board experience is confirmed by asking which syllabus codes and which years the tutor has taught, and by a short subject conversation with someone who knows the course. A confident answer about teaching IGCSE Chemistry that cannot name the paper structure does not pass. The same three checks apply whether you are hiring an IB and IGCSE private tutor in Airoli for one subject or an IB and IGCSE tutor in Mumbai for a full DP load.

There is a separate check that matters more in Navi Mumbai than parents expect, which is availability honesty. A tutor who says yes to a 6:30pm Tuesday slot in Airoli Sector 17 while already holding a 5pm slot in Kopar Khairane is not lying, they are optimistic. We ask where the previous session of the day is and how they travel, and we decline matches where the answer does not survive a rainy Wednesday. A slot that works only in perfect conditions is a slot that will be rescheduled twice a month.

Then there are the checks only you can run, and they take ten minutes. Watch the first session rather than leaving the room. Listen for whether the tutor asks the child to explain a method back, or simply demonstrates and moves on. Ask to see what the child wrote during the session, not what the tutor wrote. Ask the tutor what they will not cover, because a tutor willing to say that a topic is not their strength is a tutor telling the truth about the rest.

Finally, ask for the plan in writing after the diagnostic. It does not need to be long: three things to fix, in order, with a rough sense of how many sessions each will take. A tutor who cannot produce that has not diagnosed anything, and you will discover it in month three rather than week two. If anything in the checks looks wrong to you after the first session, say so immediately rather than giving it a term to settle.

Airoli station is one stop from Thane on the Trans-Harbour Line, and the Airoli-Mulund bridge opens the Eastern Suburbs by road. So the most useful instruction this page can give a parent is counter-intuitive: when you look for an IB and IGCSE home tutor in Airoli, search the Thane pool before you search the Nerul or Belapur one.

The arithmetic is simple once you stop reading the map as a list of Navi Mumbai nodes. Thane has a deep bench of IB and IGCSE teachers because it has a dense cluster of international and Cambridge-affiliated schools of its own, and the teachers who work in them live locally. Once you include the Thane pool, an all IB and IGCSE subjects tutor in Airoli stops being a compromise appointment and becomes a genuine subject specialist. Restrict the search to Navi Mumbai and the scarce courses, DP Chemistry HL, Economics HL, Spanish, Computer Science, are exactly the ones you will struggle to fill.

The third reason is continuity through a move. A tutor sourced from Thane survives that move. A tutor sourced from Belapur usually does not. sections.heading: What progress should look like at four weeks, one term and one exam cycle
paragraphs: At four weeks you are not looking for marks. You are looking for three things: the child opens the book before the tutor arrives, the tutor's plan from the diagnostic still matches what is actually being taught, and the homework argument at home has got shorter. If all three are true, the match is working even if the last class test looked the same as the one before it. If none of them is true after four weeks, something is wrong with the match and it should be raised then rather than at the end of term.

At one term, roughly three months, you should see movement inside the work rather than only on the report. In IGCSE that looks like full method shown on structured questions, correct units carried to the final line, and command words answered as asked: describe, explain and compare treated as three different instructions. In the MYP it looks like a rising criterion band rather than a rising percentage. In the DP it looks like an internal assessment that has an actual research question, a data table and a first draft, in October instead of February.

At one exam cycle, which for most families here means the first proper mock series, you find out what the tutoring has actually bought. Expect the picture to be uneven. A student often gains a grade in one subject and holds steady in another, because the two subjects had different problems and only one of them was content. That is a normal result, not a failure, and the right response is to rewrite the plan for the second subject rather than to change tutor.

What nobody can promise you is the grade itself. We do not guarantee grades, and any tutoring service in Mumbai that does is selling you something it cannot deliver, because the exam, the moderation and the child's own work on the day are outside anyone's control. What a good home tutor controls is preparation quality, honest feedback and the habit of starting coursework early. If a tutor is giving you those three and the grade still has not moved after a full cycle, the plan is wrong and it should be rebuilt from the diagnostic up.

One message is enough to ask for a home tutor for all IB and IGCSE subjects in Navi Mumbai and get back names who have actually taught the courses. Tell us if that is your situation at the start, because a house with one IGCSE Grade 10 student and one MYP Grade 7 student is usually better served by two specialists on different evenings than by one generalist stretched across both.

The first session follows a fixed shape. The tutor spends the first part on unaided work to establish a baseline, the middle part teaching one thing properly so the child leaves having learned something concrete, and the last few minutes with you, explaining what they found. You get the written plan afterwards. Nothing beyond that first session is committed, and if the match is wrong you say so and we go back to the shortlist.

If you would rather start with a conversation than a booking, that is fine too. Tell us the subject and the problem as you see it, and a counsellor will tell you honestly whether this needs a weekly tutor, a short block of six to eight sessions before an assessment, or simply a different study routine. Not every request that reaches us needs a tutor, and saying so costs us a booking and saves you a term.

faqs.question: What do IB and IGCSE tuition fees in Airoli depend on?
faqs.answer: IB and IGCSE tuition fees in Airoli depend on five things, and we will not quote a figure that pretends otherwise. Board and level come first: a DP Higher Level subject costs more per hour than an MYP Grade 7 subject because the teaching pool is smaller. Subject scarcity is second, which is why Economics HL or a second language sits above Mathematics. Travel distance is third, and this is where the Thane match helps you, because a shorter reliable journey keeps the rate sensible. Session length and frequency are fourth and fifth. Ask for the rate per session, not per hour, so nothing is ambiguous later.

faqs.question: Why would you send me a tutor from Thane rather than from Navi Mumbai?
faqs.answer: Because Airoli is one stop from Thane on the Trans-Harbour Line, and a Thane tutor is usually closer in real travel time than a Nerul or Belapur tutor who is three nodes south. Airoli is administratively a Navi Mumbai node, so most searches assume the tutor should also be one. In practice Thane has a deeper bench of IB and IGCSE teachers, and they can reach your sector by rail in a single stop or by road over the Thane-Belapur Road. We still check the Airoli and Ghansoli pools, but Thane is where we look first and where most Airoli matches end up coming from.

faqs.question: Can a tutor actually reach my building in Airoli on a weekday evening?
faqs.answer: Yes, provided the slot is set around the traffic rather than against it. The two routes in are Airoli station on the Trans-Harbour Line and the Airoli-Mulund bridge, and both are manageable before about 6pm and slow after it. A tutor coming by train from Thane is largely immune to the road, which is another reason that pool is matched first. For a tutor driving over the bridge from Mulund or Bhandup, we aim for 5:30pm or a weekend morning. If your preferred slot is 7:30pm on a weekday, say so early so we match someone who already lives inside the sector grid.

faqs.question: How does a home tutor get past our society gate every week?
faqs.answer: Set it up once in the first week and it stops being a problem. Most Airoli societies accept a standing visitor entry for a named tutor on a fixed day and time, registered by the flat owner at the gate or in the society's visitor app. Give the guard the tutor's name, phone number and the weekly slot, and ask whether they need an identity document photographed on the first visit. The tutor will carry one. If your society requires a fresh approval every visit, tell the tutor, because waiting ten minutes at the gate each week eats a sixth of a session over a term.

faqs.question: Does a parent need to be at home during home tuition sessions?
faqs.answer: Someone over eighteen should be in the flat, though not in the room after the first few sessions. For the diagnostic and the first two or three sessions we suggest you stay within earshot, because that is when you learn how the tutor actually teaches and whether your child responds. After that, hovering tends to make a teenager perform rather than think. Set the session up in a room with a door that stays open, a table rather than a bed, and no television in line of sight. If both parents work late, a grandparent or a responsible adult at home is enough.

faqs.question: There has been no visible progress after a month. What now?
faqs.answer: Raise it immediately, because four weeks is exactly the right time to check and the wrong time to panic. At four weeks you are measuring habits, not marks: is the book open before the tutor arrives, does the diagnostic plan still match what the school is teaching, and has the homework argument shortened. If those have not moved, we ask the tutor for their written view and compare it with yours, because the two often disagree in a useful way. The outcome is either a rewritten plan, a change of session timing, or a different tutor. All three are normal and none of them costs you a term.

faqs.question: The tutor is competent but my child has not warmed to them. Can we change?
faqs.answer: Yes, and you should, without feeling awkward about it. Subject competence and teaching fit are different things, and a tutor who is excellent with a methodical Grade 11 student can be wrong for an anxious Grade 9 one. Tell us what specifically is not landing: pace, tone, too much talking, not enough written practice. That detail is what makes the replacement better rather than merely different. We go back to the shortlist, usually with a name you already saw, and the new tutor gets the previous tutor's notes so your child does not repeat the diagnostic from scratch.

faqs.question: Does online tuition really work for IB internal assessments?
faqs.answer: For internal assessments, yes, often better than a home session. A Mathematics exploration, a Physics investigation report or a History investigation is already a document on a screen, so a tutor commenting on a shared draft in real time is working in the natural medium. Where online struggles is timed handwritten practice and younger students, because a screen cannot see a method half written and abandoned. Most Airoli families end up hybrid: the weekly home session for content and exam technique, and a shorter online slot for coursework drafting during the October to January stretch when internal assessment deadlines cluster.

faqs.question: My two children are on different boards. Can one home tutor handle both?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, and it is worth testing before assuming. A single Mathematics specialist can genuinely cover an IGCSE Grade 10 student and an MYP Grade 7 student on the same evening if the subject overlap is real. A single tutor covering IGCSE Chemistry for one child and DP History for the other cannot, whatever the CV says. Our default for a house with two different boards is two specialists on different evenings, which usually also works better for the children, because back to back sessions on one night exhaust whoever goes second. Tell us at the start and we will price and schedule it as one request.

faqs.question: How bad is the Airoli-Mulund bridge for a 7pm session?
faqs.answer: Bad enough that we plan around it rather than hope. The Airoli-Mulund bridge is the road crossing to the Eastern Suburbs, and the evening peak backs up in the direction most tutors would be travelling. For a tutor coming from Mulund or Bhandup, a 7pm weekday start is a slot that works in September and collapses in November. The fix is either a Thane-based tutor who arrives by Trans-Harbour train instead, or a weekend morning slot. If you want a weekday tutor driving over the bridge, 5:30pm is realistic and 7pm is not.

faqs.question: We are moving from Airoli to Kopar Khairane mid-year. Does the tutor continue?
faqs.answer: Usually yes, because Kopar Khairane is two stops down and inside the same matching band as Airoli and Ghansoli. Tell us as soon as the move is fixed rather than after it, so the tutor can confirm the new travel time against their other sessions before you commit. Moves in the other direction, towards Thane West or Mulund, are even easier, because most of our Airoli tutors come from that side of the creek anyway. A move deeper into Navi Mumbai, to Nerul or Belapur, is the one case where we would normally rematch you with a tutor from that node's pool.

You pick one, they run a diagnostic session at your home, and you get a written plan before any weekly slot is fixed.

sections.heading: How does IB Gram find an IB and IGCSE home tutor in Altamount Road?
paragraphs: A request for an IB and IGCSE home tutor in Altamount Road reaches us as a few lines, and a few lines are enough to start. You send one message with your child's year group, board, school and the subjects that have started slipping, and we shortlist tutors who already teach on or immediately beside Altamount Road. The first filter is not a curriculum vitae. It is whether a tutor can hold the same evening slot in your building every week for a full term, because on a road this short continuity is the thing that actually moves a grade.

The sequence is short and you control every step of it. 1. Tell us the board, the year group, the subjects and the two or three evening windows that genuinely work in your household. 2. We check which tutors already run sessions on Altamount Road, Peddar Road or Cumballa Hill at adjacent hours, because a slot sitting next to one a tutor already keeps is a slot that survives October and February. 3. You receive a shortlist showing each tutor's board experience, the components they have taught and their honest availability, assembled only after their documents have been checked. 4. You choose one, and we brief that tutor on your building's entry procedure, lift access and which room the lesson will use. 5. The first session runs as a diagnostic rather than a lesson, and you confirm a standing weekly slot afterwards.

The briefing step is not a formality here. Towers on this stretch run on prior gate entry, so a name has to reach the security desk before the tutor does, and someone arriving unannounced at seven in the evening will wait downstairs while the flat is called. We take the building name, the wing, the flat number and the preferred entry route from you at the shortlist stage, pass all of it to the tutor along with the first session time, and ask the tutor to arrive a few minutes early for the first visit only. By the second week the tutor is a familiar face at the desk and the whole question disappears.

If the diagnostic tells you the match is wrong, say so. Nobody signs anything at the start, and a parent who decides after one session that the style is too gentle or too brisk for their child has told us something useful rather than wasted anyone's time. We would rather replace a tutor in week one than watch a placement limp to December.

sections.heading: PYP, MYP, DP and IGCSE: which programme your child is actually sitting
paragraphs: Families on this stretch sit across four different assessment systems, and the right tutor depends on which one your child is in rather than on the school's name. The Primary Years Programme (PYP) has no external exams and is assessed through units of inquiry and a portfolio. The Middle Years Programme (MYP) marks every subject against four published criteria from A to D, twice a year, with the personal project landing in MYP Year 5. The Diploma Programme (DP) adds Higher Level (HL) and Standard Level (SL) choices, an Internal Assessment (IA) in almost every subject, the Extended Essay (EE) and Theory of Knowledge (TOK). Cambridge IGCSE and Pearson Edexcel International GCSE sit before the DP for most children here and are graded on terminal papers.

The practical consequence is that a brief covering all IB and IGCSE subjects in home classes Altamount Road parents book for a full year has to survive a programme change halfway through. A child in MYP Year 5 this June is an IGCSE Year 10 student next June at some schools and a DP1 student two years later, and the way work is marked changes completely each time. A tutor who only knows how to drill past papers is useful for IGCSE and close to useless in MYP, where a criterion B mark for investigating patterns rewards a method the child can explain, not a correct answer.

So when we take a brief we ask which programme, which year, and which assessment is next on the calendar, in that order. Parents often answer with the school first, which tells us less than they expect: two children in the same building, in the same year, at two different schools, can be on entirely different boards. That is ordinary in this part of Mumbai and it is the main reason we do not quote a standard package for a year group.
bullets: PYP is portfolio and inquiry based, with no external examination at the end
MYP marks four criteria per subject, A to D, reported twice yearly

sections.heading: Subject choice across both boards, and the internal assessments each one carries
paragraphs: Most requests that reach us from this road are not about one subject. They are about a combination: a child taking six DP subjects where two are shaky, or an IGCSE student deciding between Core and Extended tiers in three of them at once. A parent asking for all IB and IGCSE subjects one tutor in Altamount Road can realistically hold is asking a fair question, and the honest answer is that a single tutor covers a cluster, not a timetable. Sciences and Mathematics usually cluster together, humanities and languages cluster separately, and a serious DP Physics HL tutor is rarely the right person for an English A Language and Literature commentary.

Tier and level decisions are where a good tutor earns the slot. Choosing Extended over Core in an IGCSE subject changes the grade ceiling and the paper the child sits, and a student pushed to Extended in October who cannot hold the harder paper by February has lost ground twice. At DP level the HL and SL decision has the same shape: HL adds content, a longer paper and in several subjects a third paper, and it is worth taking only where the child needs the subject or genuinely enjoys it.

A worked example from this term. A DP2 student living on this road brought a mock Economics HL Paper 3 script to a first session. She had drawn the indirect tax diagram correctly and identified who carried the incidence, then lost the calculation marks because she worked out government revenue from the pre-tax quantity rather than the post-tax quantity, and lost evaluation marks because her final paragraph listed affected stakeholders instead of weighing the tax against one named alternative policy. None of that is a knowledge gap. The tutor's plan for the following fortnight was three timed Paper 3 questions, marked only on the calculation steps and the evaluation band, with the diagrams left alone because they were already fine. That is what subject help looks like when the diagnosis is precise.

sections.heading: Altamount Road, Peddar Road, Cumballa Hill and Tardeo: a cluster you can walk
paragraphs: Altamount Road is unusual in Mumbai because it is genuinely short. It climbs from the Kemps Corner end up towards Cumballa Hill, it holds a handful of addresses, and you can walk it end to end in the time it takes to cross one junction elsewhere in the city. That single geographic fact shapes how an IB and IGCSE home tutor in Altamount Road builds a week. A tutor finishing a six o'clock session in one tower can be sitting at a dining table in the next building by ten past seven without touching a car, which is why we treat this road as one micro cluster rather than as a set of separate addresses.

The cluster extends naturally outwards. Peddar Road runs below it and carries the traffic, Cumballa Hill sits above, and Tardeo lies across to the north east, with Grant Road the nearest suburban railway station on the Western Line. A tutor whose Tuesday already includes a lesson in Tardeo and one on Peddar Road can slot Altamount Road between them with almost no travel penalty, and that is the single most reliable way to get a good tutor into a difficult evening hour. Lodha Altamount is the named tower families mention most often when they write to us, and a tutor cleared there frequently ends up teaching two or three households within the same few hundred metres.

The travel reality beyond the cluster is less forgiving. South Mumbai is dense and short-distance but slow: a tutor crossing from Worli to Colaba covers eight kilometres and can still lose forty minutes to the Peddar Road and Haji Ali signals in the evening peak. Tutors here are usually matched within the island rather than brought down from the suburbs, however good the suburban tutor's record is. The Coastal Road and Metro Line 3 have improved some crossings, but neither helps a tutor who has to be at a desk at six thirty, three evenings a week, in term time.

paragraphs: Children on this road travel short distances to school, which is part of why families protect the evening hours so carefully. Aditya Birla World Academy in Tardeo runs the IB Diploma Programme alongside IGCSE, and Activity High School on Peddar Road is an IGCSE school, so two neighbours in the same tower can be on different pathways by Year 9. Other families here send children to Bombay International School in Babulnath or Cathedral and John Connon School in Fort. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any of these schools: we name them because their calendars set the pressure points a tutor has to plan around, and for no other reason.

Those pressure points are predictable once you have seen a few cycles. July and August are quiet and are the cheapest months to fix a weakness properly. September and October bring the first MYP criterion reports and the DP1 subject change deadline, which is when parents discover an HL choice is not holding. November and December are mock season for IGCSE and DP2, and demand for tutors on this road spikes hard enough that the good ones have no evening slots left. January and February carry DP internal assessment final deadlines and the Extended Essay hand in, stacked on top of exam preparation. March, April and May are the external papers for both boards.

A tutor who knows the local school year plans backwards from those dates rather than forwards from the day you called. If your child is in DP1 at a South Mumbai school and you are reading this in August, the useful question is not what to do this week but which HL subject is going to be the problem in January, and what has to change now so that it is not.

sections.heading: Is home tuition, online or hybrid right for a flat on Altamount Road?
paragraphs: Home tuition is the default on this road and it works because the distances are tiny. IB and IGCSE home tuition in Altamount Road means a tutor at your dining table or in the study, with the child's folder, textbooks and marked scripts open in front of both of them, for a fixed hour or ninety minutes. For younger PYP and MYP children there is no sensible alternative: attention holds in person in a way it does not on a screen, and a tutor sitting beside a child can see a wrong method being written before the answer is finished. The cost of home tuition is a tutor's travel time, which on a road this compact is close to nothing.

An IB and IGCSE online tutor in Altamount Road makes sense in three situations. The first is scarcity: if your child needs DP Computer Science HL or a less common language B, the right specialist may simply not live on the island, and a screen is better than a compromise. The second is the fortnight before exams, when a thirty minute question review at nine at night is worth more than a full session three days later. The third is monsoon, when a session that would otherwise be cancelled still happens.

Hybrid is what most families here settle into by the second term, and it is worth planning deliberately rather than drifting into it. One in-person session a week for teaching and marking, one shorter online session for drilling and doubt clearing, and the tutor marks a submitted script between the two. Being honest about the trade-offs: online loses the tutor's ability to read a child's face, it depends on a decent camera angle onto the working, and it is poor for subjects where the tutor needs to see rough work being produced. Home classes lose flexibility and cost travel time. Neither is better in the abstract, and anyone who tells you otherwise is selling the format they find convenient.

sections.heading: How does IB Gram check a tutor before the first visit?
paragraphs: Before any tutor is named to you we verify government photo identity, the degree or teaching qualification they claim, and the board experience they describe. A tutor who says they have taught DP Chemistry is asked which components, at which schools, for how many cycles, and what the internal assessment moderation feedback typically said. Vague answers end the conversation. An IB and IGCSE private tutor Altamount Road parents are about to let into their flat should be able to describe the marking criteria of the component they teach without reaching for notes, and that is a test we run before you ever meet them.

Discretion is part of verification on this road in a way it is not everywhere. Families here expect that a tutor does not discuss which flat they teach in, does not mention a child's grades to the household next door, and does not post about the work. Tutors are briefed on that explicitly alongside the gate procedure, and a breach ends the placement. We also do not publish or pass on your address, your building or your child's results to anyone outside the match.

There is a second list, and it is yours. Ask the tutor directly which syllabus version they teach and when it was last revised. Ask to see a marked script, with the student details removed. Ask how they will report to you and how often. Ask what happens to your slot during their own exam season commitments, because a tutor who also teaches at a school has a December you need to know about. Ask them to tell you, after four weeks, one thing your child is doing wrong that you had not noticed. A tutor who cannot answer that last one is not watching closely enough, and our checks cannot replace the judgement you will form in the first month.

We do not publish a price list because a DP Physics HL tutor marking two scripts a week and an IGCSE humanities tutor running one ninety minute session are not the same job. What we will tell you plainly is that IB and IGCSE home tuition in Altamount Road carries the smallest travel component of the five, and that is the quiet advantage of living on a short street.

Here is the part most pricing conversations miss. The real economics of a tutor's week on this road are about slot density, not distance. A tutor who teaches one household on Altamount Road at five and another at six thirty has earned two sessions for one journey into South Mumbai; a tutor who teaches one household and then travels to Bandra has earned one. Density is why a tutor will hold a mid cluster slot at a sensible rate and why the awkward hours, the single isolated nine o'clock session, are the expensive ones. If you can take a slot adjacent to one a tutor already keeps in a neighbouring tower, you are usually offered the better tutor and the steadier arrangement.

Which is why continuity matters more than price here, and we say that to parents who are shopping on rate alone. Changing tutors in January to save a little costs you the diagnostic month again, right when internal assessment deadlines land. The households on this road who get the most out of tuition are the ones who find a tutor in July, keep the same Tuesday and Thursday hour all year, and let the tutor build a picture of the child across two terms. The best IB and IGCSE tutor in Altamount Road for your family is usually the one who is still turning up in February, not the one with the longest credential list in August.

sections.heading: What progress looks like at four weeks, one term and one exam cycle
paragraphs: At four weeks you should see a change in how your child talks about the subject, not in the report card. The specific signals: homework started without an argument, a correct method written down before the answer, and the ability to say which part of a question they do not understand instead of saying they do not understand any of it. If none of that has shifted after four weekly sessions, something is wrong with the match and you should tell us rather than wait politely for the term to end.

At one term you should see movement in marked work. For IGCSE that usually shows as fewer dropped marks on the structured questions a child used to skip, and for MYP it shows as a criterion score moving up a band because the method is finally being communicated. At one full exam cycle, meaning a set of mocks followed by the real papers, you can fairly judge the placement overall. Even then the honest framing is that tuition improves preparation and technique: IB Gram does not guarantee grades, no tutor can, and anyone on this road promising you a 7 is telling you something about themselves rather than about your child.

IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with Aditya Birla World Academy, Activity High School or any other school named on this page. We match families to tutors, we check those tutors, and we step back in when a placement is not working. Replacing a tutor is a short conversation: tell us what is not working, whether it is pace, communication, reliability or simply that your child does not warm to them, and we shortlist again from the same cluster. You do not owe anyone an explanation, and a request to change is not treated as a complaint about the tutor.

sections.heading: Starting home tuition in Altamount Road: what to have ready
paragraphs: Three things make the first session useful instead of exploratory. The last school report or the most recent set of criterion marks. Two or three pieces of marked work, ideally the ones with the worst marks rather than the best, because that is where the pattern lives. And the two evening windows your household can genuinely protect for the next three months, allowing for the fact that nobody on this road wants a tutor arriving while dinner is on the table.

The first session itself is diagnostic. The tutor works through the marked scripts with your child, finds where the marks actually go missing, and tells you at the end what they think the problem is and what the first month will target. That conversation should be specific enough to disagree with. If the tutor finishes with a general statement about building confidence and nothing about a component, a criterion or a paper, ask a harder question or ask us for someone else.

On logistics, we ask for your building name, wing and flat, and whichever entry procedure your society uses for a recurring visitor, before the tutor sets out. A standing weekly slot is almost always easier to clear than a visitor who appears at a different hour each week, so it pays to settle the day and time early. Most households here choose a room with a door and a table, away from the television. A home tutor for all IB and IGCSE subjects Mumbai families imagine hiring is really several people over several years, so start with the subject that is hurting now and add later if it helps.

faqs.question: Can a tutor get into our building without prior gate entry being arranged?
faqs.answer: No, and that is the one thing we sort out before the first visit rather than on the evening itself. Towers on this stretch work on a prior entry basis, so the tutor's name, the flat and the expected time need to reach your security desk in advance. We collect those details from you at the shortlist stage and pass them to the tutor with the session time. After the first two or three visits the tutor is recognised at the desk and the recurring slot is cleared as a matter of routine rather than a fresh request each week.

faqs.question: We live in Lodha Altamount. How does the society clear a tutor for a standing evening slot?
faqs.answer: The same way it clears any recurring visitor, which is far easier than clearing an unpredictable one. Give us the wing, the flat and the day and hour you want held, and the tutor is briefed on your building's procedure before setting out the first time. A fixed Tuesday and Thursday arrangement is simple for a front desk to recognise; a tutor arriving at a different hour every week is not. This is exactly why we push families towards a standing slot early rather than booking session by session through the first month.

faqs.question: Do tutors travel up from the suburbs to Altamount Road in the evening?
faqs.answer: Occasionally, and we try hard to avoid it. South Mumbai is dense and short-distance but slow, so a tutor crossing from Worli to Colaba covers eight kilometres and can still lose forty minutes to the Peddar Road and Haji Ali signals in the evening peak. A suburban tutor can be excellent in September and gone by November because the commute stops being worth it. We match within the island wherever the subject allows, and only look north when a specialist genuinely does not exist closer.

faqs.question: Our tutor comes from Tardeo. Does the Grant Road end add travel time?
faqs.answer: Very little, and that is the point of this cluster. Tardeo, Cumballa Hill and Peddar Road all sit within a few minutes of Altamount Road, and Grant Road station on the Western Line serves tutors who come in by train rather than by car. The journey that causes problems is not the one within the cluster, it is the one into the island from outside it. A tutor whose Tuesday already includes a Tardeo lesson can take your hour without the schedule becoming fragile.

faqs.question: Can one tutor cover more than one subject for the same child?
faqs.answer: Within a cluster, yes. A tutor comfortable with DP Physics usually handles Mathematics alongside it, and a humanities tutor often takes two of Economics, History and Business Management. Across clusters it rarely works: asking a Chemistry specialist to also carry English A Language and Literature gets you a weak second subject and a tired first one. We would rather place two tutors in adjacent slots on the same evening, which on a road this compact costs your household almost nothing in extra disruption.

faqs.question: How quickly can a tutor start if we are already mid-term?
faqs.answer: Usually within the same week, with one honest caveat about timing. Between July and September there is slack in most tutors' schedules and you will have a real choice of people. From late October into December, when mocks are running, the strong tutors on this road have no evening slots left, and the shortlist you get in that window is shorter and the available hours are later. If you already suspect a subject is going wrong, asking in August rather than November changes who you can actually have.

faqs.question: Does online tuition really work for IB and IGCSE?
faqs.answer: For older students and specific purposes, yes; as a full replacement for a younger child, usually not. An IB and IGCSE online tutor in Altamount Road is the right call when the specialist you need is not on the island, for short revision reviews close to exams, and for sessions that monsoon would otherwise cancel. It is weaker where a tutor needs to watch rough work being produced, and it depends on a camera pointed at the page rather than at the student. Most families here end up with one session in person and one online.

faqs.question: The tutor is not working out after a few sessions. What happens?
faqs.answer: Tell us and we shortlist again, usually from the same cluster so your slot and your gate arrangement survive the change. You do not need to justify the request, and pace, communication style, reliability or simply the child not warming to the person are all reasonable grounds. Changing in the first month costs you very little. Changing in January costs you a second diagnostic month at the worst possible time, which is why we would rather hear your doubts in week three than have you wait for a report card to confirm them.

faqs.question: There has been no visible progress after a month. Is that normal?
faqs.answer: A month is too early for marks to move but not too early for the signals to appear. By week four you should see better questions, a method written down before the answer, and your child able to name the part of a topic they do not understand. If none of that has happened, something is wrong with the match or the diagnosis and we want to know. A tutor who is working will also be able to tell you one specific thing your child is doing wrong that you had not spotted yourself.

faqs.question: Will our tutor discuss our household with other families on the road?
faqs.answer: No. Discretion is briefed explicitly alongside the gate procedure, and it matters more here than in most places because a tutor on this road frequently teaches two or three households within a few hundred metres. Tutors do not discuss which flats they teach in, what a child scored, or what they saw in a home, and a breach ends the placement. IB Gram does not publish your address or your child's results either. If a tutor ever volunteers gossip about another family to you, that is the signal to call us.

faqs.question: Which schools do tutors here know best?
faqs.answer: Tutors working this cluster are generally familiar with the IB and IGCSE pathways at Aditya Birla World Academy in Tardeo and with Activity High School on Peddar Road, and many have taught children from Bombay International School and Cathedral and John Connon School as well. That familiarity is about calendars and expectations, nothing more: IB Gram is an independent platform, not affiliated with any of those schools, and a tutor's knowledge of a school's assessment rhythm is useful context rather than any form of inside track.

sections.heading: How we match an IB and IGCSE home tutor in Andheri East to your request
paragraphs: A request for an IB and IGCSE home tutor in Andheri East starts with three facts, not a form: the board, the year group, and the exact component that is going wrong. 'My daughter needs help with Chemistry' is not a brief. 'My daughter is in DP1 at Bombay Cambridge International School, taking Chemistry Standard Level (SL), and her first Internal Assessment (IA) draft is due in six weeks' is a brief a shortlist can be built against. The second version takes a parent ninety seconds longer to write and saves a fortnight of trial sessions with the wrong person.

From there the work is geographic. Andheri East sits where the Western Express Highway meets the Jogeshwari Vikhroli Link Road (JVLR), which means the pool available to a family here is drawn from two directions at once: the Western Line suburbs to the north and south, and the Powai and Chandivali belt to the east. We read the address down to the lane, because a flat off JVLR near Oberoi Splendor and a flat behind Marol station are a different proposition for the same tutor at 7pm on a Wednesday, even though they look like the same locality on a map.

Then we propose a slot before we propose a person. Any serious home tuition arrangement in Mumbai lives or dies on whether the travel holds for twelve weeks rather than one. A tutor who can be at your door at 5.45pm every Tuesday and Friday is worth more than a stronger subject specialist who can only offer 'evenings, traffic permitting'. Once the window is agreed, you get two or three profiles with the board experience spelled out and the travel route stated, and you speak to the shortlisted tutor yourself before anything is booked.

2. We confirm your address on JVLR, Marol, Chandivali or Santacruz East and a workable weekday window.

sections.heading: Which programmes and boards Andheri East families are actually choosing between
paragraphs: Three programme pathways run side by side within a short drive of Andheri East, and a parent here is usually choosing between them rather than inside one. Bombay Cambridge International School takes families through the IGCSE route under Cambridge International Education. Hiranandani Foundation School in Powai carries IGCSE cohorts into the International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme (DP). Oberoi International School on the JVLR stretch runs the full IB continuum: Primary Years Programme (PYP), Middle Years Programme (MYP) and DP. Siblings in the same flat often sit on two different systems, which is why an IB and IGCSE home tutor in Andheri East is a more common request here than a single-board one.

The crossover years are where most enquiries land. A child finishing MYP Year 5 moves into DP1 with strong inquiry habits and, often, weak examination stamina, because MYP assessment is criterion-based and continuous. A child finishing IGCSE Year 11 arrives with the opposite profile: drilled on past papers, unprepared for a four thousand word Extended Essay (EE) and for the open questions of Theory of Knowledge (TOK). A tutor who has taught both intakes can usually tell you in the first session which of the two your child is, and that single judgement reshapes the whole term's plan rather than one week of it.

Below DP the PYP and MYP years need a different kind of help, which is structure rather than revision. PYP home tuition in Mumbai is mostly reading fluency, number sense and the habit of recording thinking on paper. MYP work is about decoding command terms and the criteria each subject group is marked against, so a student stops writing a good answer to the wrong question. Pearson Edexcel International GCSE turns up here too, less often than Cambridge, and its coursework and tiering rules differ enough that a tutor needs to have taught that actual specification rather than a similar one.
